Copper Beacon Quest Guide

Game: Clockwork Estuary.

Copper Beacon is a quest in Clockwork Estuary. In Clockwork Estuary, preparation for the Copper Beacon quest begins at the harbor.

Repair the lantern and carry a spare battery before departure. Review the Copper Beacon quest objective while you are still at the harbor, then choose the marked coastal route. Return to the harbor if visibility becomes poor rather than spending the last battery far from shelter.
